cli.reason: Setup now turns off the detected local agents the member did not select before adding Agents, and `openmeld agent add` relies on Core to turn an installed, turned-off harness on before adding its Agent. Local agent checks no longer report a healthy agent as unable to start: an unfinished install check keeps the install usable, report renewal is paced from each pass start with a bounded check pool, and test tooling moves to Vitest 4. Computer details also copy Cursor's official installer for an older unsigned Cursor CLI whose `cursor-agent update` cannot run. Older CLIs keep working with current Core: Core adds an Agent for every harness turned on, so an older setup may leave unselected agents on until the member turns them off. An interrupted Computer account switch whose previous sign-in expired or was revoked now finishes recovery with OpenMeld Service left stopped, a server-renewed previous sign-in is persisted during that recovery, and `openmeld login`/`logout` finish the recovery before changing the sign-in instead of staying blocked. Wire schemas, commands, and arguments are unchanged, so the mandatory CLI floor stays at 0.3.251.

service.reason: Background local agent reports now renew inside Core's two-minute check window (cadence from pass start, three checks at a time) and an unfinished launch check no longer reports repair. The Service's agent registry gains a setup helper that registers unselected agents turned off, and its Cursor version advisory reports the official installer when an older unsigned CLI cannot update itself and compares Homebrew cask revisions by their SemVer core. Shared auth-session storage now persists a server-confirmed renewal of the restored previous sign-in while a Computer recovery is pending, and recovery cleanup releases a replaced previous token, without changing the journal shape. Older Services stay compatible, and Core alone already stops showing an expired report as Can't start; Service transport, reporting, execution, and Wake contracts are unchanged, so the mandatory Service floor remains 0.3.264.

skills.reason: Guidance clarifies existing command prefixes, addressing, and Computer operations without adding runtime authority.
